reviewed_conditions: Minimum formula uses second London fixing and gold fineness; not this project reference feed.
18K minimum: 55% of fineness-adjusted reference, with exclusions for hollow gold/nonprecious components; French 18K hallmark condition.
14K minimum: 50% of fineness-adjusted reference.
9K minimum: 45% of fineness-adjusted reference; source incorrectly associates 9K with 333 per mille.
Shipping and insurance remain seller costs; taxes may be withheld separately; bullion commission table not applied to scrap.
review_notes: No directly quoted EUR/g buyer rates extracted.
9K/333 purity inconsistency requires resolution; do not silently correct.
Exact costs and applicable source reference time required before deriving any minimum amount.
